reuseRules: Generate worker identity briefs directly from catalog IDs; VBO:0200156 is Berger de Savoie and VBO:0201368 is Trail Hound, not Briquet de Savoie or Treeing Tennessee Brindle.

Keep original writer packets immutable; peer-reviewed corrected packets and subsequent source dispositions supersede them.
Editorial approval does not approve references, prompts, portrait generation, suitability claims or crossbreed predictability.
